title: The template kit tool reads a WordPress-generated picture size as the upload its slot names
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A -WxH or -scaled size of a slot's upload adds no frame; another file's size, a name ending in digits and a non-WordPress path still do.

tests: a generated size of a slot picture is held by the slot, so no frame no slot holds is added
another picture, a size of another file, or a file whose own name ends in digits is still a frame of its own
